purpose: fresh-seed validation of the fixed-PDC contract for corr40-split-v3 before any result on these seeds is seen
L_rule: 0.25 ms grid value minimising the largest |attack residual| on the known-seed study inputs (holdout 8139/20261024, long 1); same L for every shift
metric: per-event added delay of the 1-8 kHz 2 ms RMS attack peak (output minus input), T1 validity (inputs whose own attack peaks all lie within 10 ms); residual = added delay - L

pass_rule.attack_residual: max |attack residual| <= 4.5 ms at each of 44.1/48/96 kHz (known-seed 3.083 ms + 1.0 ms, rounded up to 0.5 ms, as the T3 ceiling rule)
pass_rule.report_only: attack residual p5/p95, low-band onset residual (not compensated by L), comparison with reporting 0

rules: single run; no change to L, metric, threshold or inputs after seeing results
